title: The IEA Wind 2200-22-MW Reference Offshore Wind Plants
description: This repository contains the data and computational tools defining the IEA Wind 2200-22-MW Reference Offshore Wind Plants, encoded following the windIO ontology. The reference plants comprise three closely spaced wind plants with a total of 100 IEA Wind 22-MW turbines, exhibiting strong internal and external wake interactions.
